question: Where is Morgan Stanley investing in technology for its advisors?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Morgan Stanley's CEO describes AI as an existentially important top priority, with the firm overweighted to AI in wealth from its early work with OpenAI.
items.quote: We were, as you know, overweighted to AI from the early days in wealth with some of the work we did with OpenAI... There is just no question that this is existentially important that we are viewed as a trusted adviser in the middle of the ecosystem... And for us to be part of the content and the thinking and the evolution of this is absolutely the top priority for the firm as the adviser

items.text: Morgan Stanley identifies AI use cases including DevGen AI, Parable, and LeadIQ, which focuses on matching workplace and self-directed relationships and facilitating engagement with financial advisors.
items.quote: These include the DevGen AI tool, which enhances developer efficiency by modernizing code, Parable, an interactive tool that quickly analyzes and summarizes data, and LeadIQ, our AI-powered lead distribution platform, focusing on matching workplace and self-directed relationships and facilitating engagement with our financial advisors.

items.text: Morgan Stanley describes technology as investing in broadening capabilities for financial advisors that are difficult for others to replicate: alternatives and privates, tax-efficient investing, digitized assets, family office and OCIO, and tailored lending.
items.quote: We are using our scale to invest in broadening capabilities for FAs that are difficult for others to replicate: alternatives and privates, tax-efficient investing, digitized assets, family office and OCIO, and tailored lending.

items.text: Morgan Stanley continues to invest in future technology including AI and digital tools, with scale supporting continued investment.
items.quote: our scale supports continued investment in future technology, including AI and digital tools.

items.text: Morgan Stanley describes technology as a differentiator in its favor, built against the platform of self-directed, workplace and financial advisor channels.
items.quote: against that platform, we have built a number of advantages that not only allow us to preserve our moat, but actually make technology a differentiator in our favor.

items.text: Morgan Stanley's CEO describes technology as being able to help financial advisors do a lot of the early work on clients' complex financial decisions, while remaining a people business.
items.quote: if the technology is world-class, folks want to make decisions with their financial advisers based on the complexity and singularity of their own financial needs... that is something that technology can help do a lot of the early work.

items.text: Morgan Stanley states it is investing in technology, distribution, and product innovation to serve its global client base across its franchise.
items.quote: our ongoing investments in technology, distribution, and product innovation position our diversified franchise to better serve our global client base.

cells.reason: Multiple passages describe Morgan Stanley's technology priorities for the advisor business, including AI, digital tools, and capabilities for financial advisors.
